issue01.title: Between Worlds
issue01.subtitle: A new chapter — resonance, encounters, and what grows in silence.
issue01.description: A new chapter of La Vie Nomade & ERPA — foreword, whispers, culture of resonance, portraits, Frequency Dance Night, Resonance, Troubadours, and thanks to the community.
issue01.forewordQuote: Some stories disappear, while others grow quiet — and transform.
issue01.forewordBody:
This is the first edition of our magazine. Not as proof that we have arrived, but as a marker — of what is moving, what is shifting, and what is beginning to take form.

Between worlds is not a place you visit. It is where you already are — when you stop explaining and start listening.

What follows is a collection of voices, reflections, and encounters from the field. Some emerged from silence. Others from movement. All of them carry something that resists being pinned down — and that is precisely their value.

Welcome to this space between.
